description:
Priority: P1 (style). File: Cargo.toml (root [workspace.lints] + [lints] workspace = true on each member). Reference: hare (strict, gold standard) or aviary (advisory).

Problem: No lint policy is declared. Decide and encode one.

Change (recommended — hare's strict model):
  - [workspace.lints.rust] with unsafe_code = "deny".
  - [workspace.lints.clippy] deny-by-default groups (suspicious, complexity, perf, cargo at priority = -1), a pedantic = "warn" ratchet, cherry-picked denies (cloned_instead_of_copied, filter_map_next, float_cmp, implicit_clone, manual_assert), and a documented allow list.
  - [lints] workspace = true on the root package and on crates/migrations/Cargo.toml and crates/client/Cargo.toml.
  - Lighter alternative (aviary): [workspace.lints.clippy] all = "warn" and rely on the -D warnings command (TPL-003) for enforcement, keeping plain cargo build non-fatal.

Acceptance: cargo clippy-strict passes on the placeholder template code; all three workspace members opt into the shared lints.
Note: separate from TPL-004 (different region of Cargo.toml); sequence after it.
title: [TPL-007] Add a [workspace.lints] table
